from collections import Counter,defaultdict
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
def comps(g,bg):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if (r,c) in seen or g[r][c]==bg: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for dr in(-1,0,1):
                    for dc in(-1,0,1):
                        na,nb=a+dr,b+dc
                        if 0<=na<len(g) and 0<=nb<len(g[0]) and (na,nb) not in seen and g[na][nb]==col:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); q.append((na,nb))
            out.append((col,frozenset(cells)))
    return out

import numpy as np,collections
def analyze(name):
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    H,W=I.shape
    bg=collections.Counter(I.flatten().tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps(g,bg):
        seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                    st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]; seen[i,j]=True
                    while st:
                        a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b,int(g[a,b])))
                        for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x,y]!=bg and not seen[x,y]:
                                seen[x,y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                    out.append(comp)
        return out
    Cs=comps(I,bg)
    big=max(Cs,key=len)
    a0=min(a for a,b,_ in big); b0=min(b for a,b,_ in big)
    rel=[(a-a0,b-b0,v) for a,b,v in big]
    tmpl={key:(v) for key,v in collections.defaultdict(list) for key in [key] for v in [v]} if False else None
    bycol=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for a,b,v in rel: bycol[v].append((a,b))
    print(name,'bg',bg,'template cells by color:',{k:sorted(v) for k,v in sorted(bycol.items())})
    marks=[(i,j,int(I[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i,j]!=bg and sum(1 for a,b,v in rel if (a,b)==(i-j+a0,b-j+b0)...)] 
    # markers = singletons not in object
    obj=set((a,b) for a,b,_ in big)
    marks=[(i,j,int(I[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i,j]!=bg and (i,j,a0_offset:=0) and not ((i-a0,j-b0) in {(p[0]-a0,p[1]-b0) for p in big})]
    # simpler: marker if its normalized position not in obj and it's isolated
    mkset={(p[0]-a0,p[1]-b0) for p in big}
    marks=[(i,j,int(I[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i,j]!=bg and (i-a0,j-b0) not in mkset]
    return I,O,bg,rel,marks
